decisions.statement: Every source is asked unless the caller names the sources to ask.
A source the player has not installed answers nothing.
A price read from a source is held for five minutes.
A price from Master Merchant is read again on every ask.
A price from any source is turned into the one shape this library answers in.
Another add-on reaches this library through a name in the global table.
This library depends on no other add-on.

definition: what an item is worth, gathered from every trading add-on the player has
